label: One relay cut preserves bottom activity exactly at or above a maintained feed
paraphrase: Fix receiver zero and one power on a natural-number successor roster. The all-active intact profile and a family of single-cut responses exist for both the relay-only model and each model with its sole separate active feed at depth d. Cutting the link i+1 into i extinguishes receiver zero in every relay-only response. With a maintained separate active feed at depth d, receiver zero stays active in every admissible response exactly when d ≤ i. Thus d is the least cut position preserving the receiver's activity, including d = 0. For any bound k, depth k+1 reproduces failure at every i ≤ k and preserves activity at the next cut.
